finalYear.title: Development of a Laboratory Prototype of PID-Based Ball and Beam Balancing System for Educational Purpose
finalYear.description: A comprehensive final year project focused on designing and building a PID-based control system for educational demonstrations of balancing dynamics.
bullets: Developed a laboratory prototype of a Ball and Beam Balancing System to demonstrate PID control principles.
Designed the mechanical structure and integrated sensors and actuators for real-time feedback and control.
Implemented tuning algorithms for the PID controller to achieve stable and rapid balancing.

hardware.title: Three-Phase-Motor-Control-Circuit (Copyright Filed)
hardware.description: A formally copyrighted industrial control circuit featuring Hand–Off–Auto selector integration and pressure switch automation for three-phase motors.
bullets: Authored and filed a copyright for this industrial motor control system design.
Engineered manual and automatic mode operations using an HOA selector switch.
Integrated an overload relay for thermal protection and a contactor for high-power switching.
Implemented pressure-based automatic state transitions for safe and reliable motor operations.

hardware.title: IoT-Based-Temperature-Monitoring-System
hardware.description: A real-time industrial temperature monitoring system using DHT22 sensor with automated alerts and data logging.
bullets: Designed a real-time temperature and humidity monitoring system using DHT22 sensor.
Implemented threshold-based buzzer alarm for overtemperature protection.
Integrated ESP8266 WiFi module for remote monitoring via web dashboard.
Added 16x2 LCD display for local temperature readout.

hardware.title: Automated-Water-Pump-Controller
hardware.description: An intelligent water level sensing and automatic pump control system for overhead tank management.
bullets: Built an automatic water level detection system using HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor.
Implemented relay-based motor control to automate pump ON/OFF based on water level.
Added LED indicator panel showing LOW / MEDIUM / FULL tank status.
Designed fail-safe dry-run protection to prevent motor damage.

hardware.title: Smart-Home-Automation-System
hardware.description: An IoT-based central automation hub controlling home appliances over WiFi with real-time status updates.
bullets: Developed an IoT automation hub using NodeMCU to control multiple home appliances via WiFi.
Integrated the Blynk platform for mobile application control and real-time status monitoring.
Designed a modular relay switching circuit ensuring safe isolation for high-voltage appliances.

hardware.title: RFID-Based-Smart-Attendance
hardware.description: An automated IoT attendance logging system using RFID tags and a cloud database to track entries.
bullets: Engineered an automated attendance system scanning passive RFID tags for secure access logging.
Interfaced an ESP8266 Wi-Fi module to push timestamped attendance data directly to Google Sheets via API.
Implemented LED and buzzer feedback mechanisms for successful and denied access attempts.

hardware.title: PWM-Solar-Charge-Controller
hardware.description: A pulse-width modulation based solar charge controller for 12V lead-acid battery with overcharge and deep-discharge protection.
bullets: Designed a PWM-based solar charge controller for 12V battery systems.
Implemented overcharge protection with MOSFET switching at 14.4V cutoff.
Added deep-discharge protection to extend battery lifespan.
Built real-time voltage and current monitoring with 16x2 LCD display.

hardware.title: Smart-Energy-Meter
hardware.description: A real-time electrical energy consumption monitoring system with IoT-enabled web dashboard for tracking power usage and costs.
bullets: Developed an IoT-based energy metering system measuring real-time voltage, current, and power.
Integrated ACS712 current sensor and ZMPT101B voltage transformer for accurate readings.
Built a ThingSpeak cloud dashboard for remote monitoring and historical data analysis.
Added OLED display for local real-time power consumption readout in kWh.
